name: Dark Stat
tagline: story-telling's dark editorial kit: near-black, one sky-blue accent, Space Grotesk 800 headlines with tight tracking, a stat per scene.

motion.direction: marketcalls story kit. Eyebrow (28 px, tracking 10, accent `ter`) + headline (Space Grotesk 800, 84 px, line-height 0.96, tracking −5) + subline (44 px, muted) as the title `chapterCard`; ONE stat per scene as a `counter` (72 px, −3 tracking) in a bordered `lockCard` with a 2 px accent border and radius 20; scenes ≈ 10 s, titles enter 26 frames with ease (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) rising 40 px and fade before the subs get busy. Captions: white phrase groups with a heavy dark shadow, bottom-anchored. No red/green switching, no charts as artwork, nothing hard-cut.
